title: Set a Measurable Acceptance Rule Before Work Starts
teaser: A vague definition of done creates avoidable disagreement at delivery time.
message: Choose one deliverable for May and write the measurable condition that must be true before it can be accepted.

title: Check How an Optional Profile Field Stores Empty Input
teaser: An empty value should not silently become information the user never supplied.
message: Leave one optional field blank in a test profile then save and reopen it to verify the value remains intentionally empty.

title: Compare a Calculation with a Trusted Worked Example
teaser: A plausible final number does not prove every transformation in the formula is correct.
message: Use a documented reference example and compare important intermediate values as well as the final result.

title: Reach a Primary Action Without Touch Input
teaser: A control that works by tapping may still be inaccessible from a keyboard or assistive device.
message: Navigate one core screen using only keyboard focus and confirm the primary action can be reached and activated with visible focus.

title: Verify the Schema Version Inside a Fresh Backup
teaser: Restoring data without knowing its schema version makes compatibility difficult to prove.
message: Create a safe test backup and confirm its manifest declares the schema version expected by the current restore path.

title: Reject a Date Range Whose Start Comes After Its End
teaser: Silently correcting reversed dates can hide user mistakes and change the intended query.
message: Enter a start date later than the end date and verify validation blocks the action with a clear explanation.

title: Inspect Logs for Sensitive Fields
teaser: Local logs can still expose private information when devices or diagnostic reports are shared.
message: Run one test flow and verify passwords tokens private notes and other unnecessary sensitive values are absent from logs.

title: Invoke a PRO Operation Directly from Free State
teaser: A lock icon is not an authorization boundary.
message: From a Free test state call one protected operation through a direct route or deep link and confirm entitlement enforcement rejects it.

title: Render a PDF with a Long Paragraph Across Pages
teaser: Long content can disappear if pagination clips text at a page boundary.
message: Generate a test PDF with valid long-form content and verify the paragraph continues cleanly onto the next page without loss.

title: Keep Different Currencies Out of a Single Total
teaser: Adding unlike currencies produces a number with no reliable financial meaning.
message: Create records in two currencies and confirm reporting keeps each currency in its own labeled section instead of merging totals.

title: Read the Empty State of a Core List
teaser: An unexplained blank screen can look like failed loading rather than an intentional empty state.
message: Open a list with no records and verify the screen explains the state and offers an appropriate next action.

title: Save a Change While the Device Is in Airplane Mode
teaser: A slow connection is not the same test as complete network absence.
message: Enable airplane mode change a safe local record restart the app and confirm the update remains available from local storage.

title: Remove Certainty from One Interpretive Statement
teaser: Symbolic guidance should not be presented as guaranteed future fact.
message: Review one interpretation and replace any absolute prediction with language that clearly communicates possibility or tendency.

title: Try Importing a CSV with an Unknown Column
teaser: Unexpected fields can conceal format drift when an importer accepts them without a defined rule.
message: Add one undefined column to a test CSV and verify the importer handles it exactly as the format contract specifies.

title: Check Form State After Navigating Away and Back
teaser: Losing expected state during navigation forces users to repeat work and can cause accidental edits.
message: Enter safe draft values in a form navigate elsewhere then return and verify state retention matches the documented lifecycle behavior.

title: Make an Error Message Point Toward Recovery
teaser: An error code alone rarely tells a user what can be done next.
message: Trigger one expected validation error and confirm the message describes the problem and a safe corrective action.

title: Verify One Production Dependency Is Exactly Resolved
teaser: Open-ended dependency resolution can make identical source produce different builds.
message: Choose one production package and confirm its exact resolved version is traceable in the lock or equivalent resolution record.

title: Test a Local Time Around a Daylight-Saving Transition
teaser: Clock changes can create local times that are ambiguous or do not exist.
message: Use a trusted DST region and verify parsing and display near the transition follow the documented time-zone rules.

title: Require Deliberate Confirmation Before Permanent Deletion
teaser: An irreversible action should not execute because of one accidental tap.
message: Start permanent deletion for a test record and confirm data remains untouched until an explicit confirmation step is completed.

title: Expose the Date Range Used by a Report
teaser: A correct result can still be misunderstood when the covered period is invisible.
message: Generate a test report and verify its start and end dates are clearly shown in the output.

title: Test Search with Different Letter Case
teaser: Inconsistent normalization can make the same record appear or disappear depending on capitalization.
message: Search for the same term using different casing and confirm results follow the product's documented normalization rule.

title: Verify the Hash of an Approved UI Reference
teaser: Regression evidence becomes unreliable if the reference changes without its provenance record changing too.
message: Pick one approved UI reference and confirm its recorded hash matches the actual repository asset.

title: Read the Warning Before Starting Restore
teaser: Users should know which data may change before a restore begins.
message: Inspect the restore confirmation step and verify it explains affected data scope and any available recovery path before execution.

title: Trace a CI Gate to the Exact Artifact It Checks
teaser: Running a validation script does not prove the intended release file was examined.
message: Inspect one release job and verify the checked artifact hash belongs to the exact file produced by that job.

title: Confirm Units Remain Visible Around a Calculation
teaser: A correct numeric value can be misread when its unit disappears.
message: Choose one unit-bearing calculation and verify expected input and output units remain explicit in both the UI and exported result.

title: Look for Old-Locale Text After Switching Languages
teaser: Cached text from the previous locale can leave an interface partially translated.
message: Switch between Turkish and English then visit core screens and verify no fixed label from the prior locale remains.

title: Prove State Is Unchanged After an Authorization Failure
teaser: A rejected request may still have mutated data before the guard returned an error.
message: Trigger one unauthorized test operation and compare critical values and record counts before and after the rejection.

title: Measure First Usable Render with a Large List
teaser: A screen that performs well on small data may become slow at realistic scale.
message: Open a representative large list and compare time to first usable view against the documented performance threshold.

title: Round-Trip One Export into a Clean Test Environment
teaser: An export file opening successfully does not prove its data can be restored faithfully.
message: Export a safe dataset import it into a clean test environment and compare critical fields with the originals.

title: Write the Condition That Would Reverse a Technical Decision
teaser: Temporary choices tend to become permanent when nobody records when they should be reconsidered.
message: For one current decision write the measurement or event that would justify reversing it.

title: Close May with One Measured Improvement
teaser: A change is difficult to evaluate when success is based only on impression.
message: Pick one improvement from this month and record the same before-and-after measurement so its effect can be compared.
